title: Avatar
summary: Shows a person or organisation as a photo or initials, with an optional availability or verification mark. The default and label templates render a native button whose aria-label names its action; the card template is static and adds a title, description and meta line.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

size.description: The avatar's size on the ladder: 1/4 and 1/3 for a mark beside small text, 1 the default, 2 and 3 for a profile. On a desktop 20 / 24 / 32 / 40 / 48 / 56 px for 1/4 to 3; in a compact region (data-sf-density="compact") every step moves one down the avatar's ladder, 16 / 20 / 24 / 32 / 40 / 48; the phone ladder is 20 / 20 / 28 / 36 / 44 / 52.

line.description: Takes the text line of this form size instead of a control height, for an avatar beside a label in a row or a table cell.

shape.description: circle (the default) for a person, square for a company, a group or a project.

image-url.description: The picture's address. Empty: the initials of text (or of heading), else the person placeholder.

image-alt.description: The picture's alternative text, when the picture says something the visible name does not.

no-wrap.description: Keeps heading and description on one line each in the label and card templates, cut with an ellipsis when the place is narrower.

text.description: The initials drawn when there is no picture; empty takes them from heading.

hue.description: The hue of the static palette the initials are drawn in (owner decision C17): the plate is the hue's container, the ink its on-container. Empty: the neutral look. auto: one of eight hues (pink, amber, lime, green, teal, sky, indigo, purple) picked from the name (heading, else aria-label, else text) by a fixed hash, the same in every browser and on a server; no name, the neutral look. Only initials take a hue: an image and the placeholder stay as they are. --sf-avatar-background-color and --sf-avatar-color still win.

tone.description: The former name of hue, until 2027-01-01: read when hue is empty, rose as pink and violet as purple (the tones of initials are the static hues of their names since C17). Write hue.

status.description: A mark at the corner: online, offline, the company badge or the verified badge; none draws nothing.

heading.description: The person's name in the label and card templates; also the source of the initials.

description.description: The line under the name in the label and card templates: a role, a team.

meta.description: A short fact in the card template, such as a city, with meta-icon before it.

meta-icon.description: The glyph before meta in the card template (a Material Symbols name).

card-variant.description: The card template's picture: square (the default) or portrait, a tall picture over the text.

disabled.description: Draws the avatar unavailable and, where it is a button, makes it inert.

badge-count.description: A count on the avatar (simai/ui-source#12): a whole number above 0 shows, 0 or empty hides the badge. Above badge-cap it reads «<cap>+»; the exact number joins the avatar's accessible name («Анна Белова, 3 непрочитанных») and the badge's tooltip. On an anchor of size 1/3 or 1/2 a count is drawn as a dot.

badge-dot.description: A dot on the avatar, a count with no number: something new. Shown when badge-count is not set; with a count, the count is drawn as a dot. Its text equivalent («есть новое» / «new» by default, badge-label to change it) joins the accessible name.

badge-cap.description: The largest count drawn as a number; a larger one reads «<cap>+».

badge-label.description: The words the badge adds to the accessible name and its tooltip, in place of the page language's default: for a dot the whole text equivalent; for a count the phrase in plural forms separated by «|» (one|few|many in Russian, one|other in English) with {count} where the number goes.

aria-label.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Avatar" in English).

accessibility.focus: Keep visible focus on the active control.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-avatar when the interface needs the avatar behavior.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
